verdict.rationale: Exa publishes self-serve per-request pricing on its public pricing pages: Deep Search at $12–15 per 1k requests and Answer at $5 per 1k requests. Contents are included at no extra charge for up to 10 results per search. Sign-up gives free credits with no payment method required, credits and auto recharge are managed self-serve, and Agent runs return a cost breakdown, so no sales contact appears needed. Missing for 10: an explicit per-1k price for the core Search endpoint, explicit Websets/Agent per-unit pricing, and independent or hands-on corroboration of pricing clarity.
